meta.name: lsp
meta.description: Use when Codex needs language-server diagnostics, definitions, references, symbols, or rename safety checks in the current workspace.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在编辑器中获取代码诊断、定义跳转和引用查找
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在代码编辑器中快速定位定义、引用或检查重命名安全
copy.tagline_en: Get language diagnostics, definitions, references, and rename safety in your editor
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need quick access to definitions, references, and rename safety in your code editor

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 可以通过语言服务器工具检查代码报错、跳转到符号定义、查找引用、安全重命名,也能列出当前已配置的语言服务器状态。
howto.when: 当你请它检查代码报错、查找某个符号的定义或引用、或安全重命名时,就会调用语言服务器工具。

say.text: 打开的文件里有报错吗?帮我看看哪里有问题。
say.note: 会调用 diagnostics 检查当前文件

say.text: 帮我找一下 handleClick 的定义和被引用的地方。
say.note: 调用定义与引用查找工具

say.text: 把 App 组件里的 visible 变量安全重命名为 isOpen。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can use language-server tools to check code diagnostics, jump to definitions, find references, rename safely, and list configured language servers.
howto.when_en: It activates when you ask Claude to check code errors, locate a symbol's definition or usages, or perform a safe rename.

say_en.text: Are there errors in the open file? Please check.
say_en.note: Calls diagnostics on the current file

say_en.text: Find where handleClick is defined and referenced.
Safely rename variable visible to isOpen in App component.
